label: The live command surface is 45 markdown files: 44 grouped commands plus local-skilled-alignment.md; only 19 appear in a command-metadata.json because only system-deep-loop, sk-design and sk-doc publish command metadata.
The generated projection has 62 entries from 19 command-metadata rows, 8 allow-list rows and 35 doctor routes, collapsing to 43 distinct command spellings.
Four live grouped commands have no generated bridge: /prompt:improve, /speckit:handoff, /speckit:save and /speckit:search; the allow-list bridges /prompt under its retired spelling.
Three generated bridges name non-live spellings: /spec_kit is deprecated, /memory:save is a retained legacy key and /prompt is the legacy name for /prompt:improve.

Activation is platform-specific: 40 of 62 entries are active for TypeScript and 50 for Python; 22 entries are TypeScript-inactive, including every /deep:*, every /design:*, 11 of 13 /create:* and four /speckit:* commands.

The doctor family is the only fully connected slice: every derived doctor bridge is active in both scorers and doctor-phrase-reach.cjs proves its phrase coverage, while no equivalent reach proof exists for the other families.

A drift-proof inventory needs one command-tree-derived registry with a completeness gate: every command file must carry owner metadata or an allow-list justification, and a bridge naming a non-live spelling must fail validation; the current deriver never compares its three inputs to the live tree.
